p.src: 1  Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—

ja: が、ほめたたえられますように。
en: Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—
u.src: 1  Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—

p.src: 2  my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.

ja: しむ方、私のとりで、 私の
en: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.
u.src: 2  my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.

p.src: 3  LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

ja: なので、あなたは彼を顧みられるのだろう。
なので、心に留められるのだろう。
en: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
u.src: 3  LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

p.src: 4  Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

en: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
u.src: 4  Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

p.src: 5  Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

ja: れて、煙を上げさせてください。
en: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
u.src: 5  Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

p.src: 6  Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

en: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
u.src: 6  Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

p.src: 7  Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,

ja: ばし、 大水から私を引き上げ、
en: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
u.src: 7  Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,

p.src: 8  whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

en: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
u.src: 8  whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

p.src: 9  I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

en: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.
u.src: 9  I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

p.src: 10  You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

ja: え、 しもべダビデを、死をもたらす
en: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
u.src: 10  You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

p.src: 11  Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

ja: から、私を引き上げ、救い出してください。
en: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
u.src: 11  Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

p.src: 12  Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

ja: のようになり、 私たちの
を飾るために刻まれた柱のようになる。
en: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
u.src: 12  Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

p.src: 13  Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

ja: ち、あらゆる産物であふれる。 私たちの
en: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
u.src: 13  Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

p.src: 14  Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

ja: を引く。 城壁が破られることも、連れ去られることもなく、 広場に叫び声が上がることもない。
en: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
u.src: 14  Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

p.src: 15  Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.

en: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.
u.src: 15  Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.
